metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Brain Vision ACTICHAMP system with 64 electrodes. Preprocessing included high-pass (0.10 Hz) and low-pass (45 Hz) filtering with 4th order IIR Butterworth filters, re-referencing to average mastoid activity (TP9 and TP10), and ICA-based removal of eye-related artifacts. Data were epoched from 1.87 seconds before to 3.17 seconds after target picture onset (5.04 second epochs). Participants completed a picture-matching task with four cue types (Physical, Imagery, Literal, Metaphorical) in a counterbalanced block design with inter-stimulus intervals of 700 ms (Physical, Literal, Metaphorical) or 3000 ms (Imagery).

funding.award_title: PROcessing MEtaphors: Neurochronometry Acquisition and Decay (PROMENADE)
